entities.summary: Tokuji Hayakawa  was a Japanese businessman and the founder of Hayakawa Kinzoku Kōgyō. He invented and patented the “Tokubijō” belt buckle in 1912 and invented the "Ever Ready Sharp" mechanical pencil in 1915.
